Class HexahedronMeters

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.attributetypes.SysMLAttributeType
sysmlinjava.attributetypes.HexahedronMeters
All Implemented Interfaces:
ObservableAttribute
public class HexahedronMeters extends SysMLAttributeType
SysMLinJava value type for a hexahedron (6-sides) in terms of its height, width, and length in meters

    • createUnits

      protected void createUnits()
      Description copied from class: SysMLAttributeType
      Required operation to create/assign the units attribute for this attribute type. The units variable should be assigned with the name of a SysMLUnit instance located in an extension of the SysMLUnits class. An example is as follows: 
      @Override
protected void createUnits()
{
        units = SysMLinJavaUnits.FeetCubic;
}
